infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Social Circle uses your location to show nearby events and improve discovery.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow camera access to take photos for events and your profile.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Allow photo library access to choose images for events and your profile.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: We save event photos and profile pictures to your library on request.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Allow reminders access if you choose to manage reminders in Social Circle.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Allow calendar access so you can add events to your calendar.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: We use analytics to improve app performance and personalize your experience. Your data is never sold.
